blocks.text: This page is a dedication in the opening matter of Volume II rather than the start of the Ahmad Shah and Sukha Singh narrative. It is addressed plainly and reverently: Dedicated to Dr Kharak Singh.
The short dedication praises him as the guide and the guardian of the translator’s heart and soul. Instead of episode action, the page offers a compact statement of gratitude and moral indebtedness.

The repaired summary keeps that front-matter function explicit so the in-app reader does not mistake it for damaged narrative text. It should be read as a dedication page that honors Dr Kharak Singh before the volume proceeds into its contents and episodes.
